text:
Eden (sec): FYI we're scheduling a targeted base-image rebake Thu 03:00 UTC to address last week's vuln scan and drop legacy package caches. Need RBAC gating, KMS signing approach, and audit forwarding cleared. Plan tag: base-slim-core:2026-03-26.

Sam (eng-infra): Proposed minimal RBAC: ClusterRole 'rebake-signer' limited to secrets/get and secrets/create in namespace 'ci-builds' + RoleBinding scoped to ServiceAccount 'rebake-runner@ci'. I will add annotation `rbac.redwood.io/allow-keystore: "true"`. Any devs relying on broader perms?

Keiko (eng-runtime): Runtime needs a cache eviction header `X-Rebuild-Tag` support; we'll wire a purge endpoint accepting the tag. Also recommend keeping the previous cosign key valid for 48h after cut to enable quick rollbacks.

Rafael (eng-sre): Preflight plan: 02:00 UTC smoke, 02:40 UTC canary on 2 nodes, 03:00 full rollout. I'll run image pull and container runtime health checks. Please post build id here once CI completes.

CI-Bot: Build queued: base-rebake-2026-03-26T03:00Z id=br-7210. Artifact stored at gs://prod-images/rebakes/br-7210. Trigger: manual by Eden.

Eden (sec): Audit asks: forward KMS audit entries to Splunk index 'security.kms' during the window, include signing metadata (key-id, key-version, caller) in artifact annotations, and retention 30d. Also exclude any images labeled `runtime=musl` from this run per vuln triage.

Sam (eng-infra): Decision point: HSM vs software-KMS for prod. HSM gives attestation and non-exportability; software KMS is faster for CI. Suggest: sign staging with software KMS, verify, then prod with HSM and keep software key active as 48h fallback. Thoughts?

Keiko (eng-runtime): That flow sounds good. Note: musl-linked microimages still failing libc-based hooks; excluding them is safer. We'll add label-based exclusion in CI pipeline: `if image.labels.runtime == "musl" then skip_rebake`.

Rafael (eng-sre): Preflight checklist I'll mark here: 1) RBAC applied to staging and binding tested 2) cosign sign/verify w/ kms:// path smoke 3) purge endpoint accepts `X-Rebuild-Tag` 4) old tags resolvable for rollback 5) runbook linked to pager.

Eden (sec): Please also annotate RoleBinding with a TTL `rbac.redwood.io/ttl: "5h"` so signing privileges auto-expire. And add `security.audit/source: "rebake-2026-03-26"` on artifacts.

Sam (eng-infra): RBAC for staging pushed: ClusterRole `rebake-signer-staging` + RoleBinding to sa/rebake-runner. Quick test: `kubectl auth can-i create secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:ci-builds:rebake-runner` -> yes.

Keiko (eng-runtime): Verified cosign on staging key: `cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebake/cryptoKeys/stagingKey br-7210` -> verification OK. Purge endpoint accepted header: `curl -XPOST https://runtime.internal/purge -H 'X-Rebuild-Tag: base-slim-core:2026-03-26'` -> 202 accepted.

Rafael (eng-sre): Running 02:00 UTC preflight now. Watchlist: image-pull-backoff, kubelet OOM events, cosign verification failures, signing latency causing CI step timeouts.

Eden (sec): If preflight green, proceed with staging. For prod use HSM-backed key and enable Splunk ingest rule for `proto:cosign` w/ retention 30d. I'll notify SOC and compliance.

Sam (eng-infra): I'll attach short audit runbook and Splunk ingest snippet to the PR. Also applying `rbac.redwood.io/runner-pool: "rebake"` annotation so only the rebake runners get the binding.

Rafael (eng-sre): Preflight complete: RBAC validated, cosign sign/verify ok, purge endpoint ok. Canary scheduled. No regressions observed so far. Proceeding to canary at 02:40 UTC. Logs will be posted to /var/log/rebake/br-7210/*. If rollout issues appear I'll trigger rollback to tag `base-slim-core:rollback-20260326`.

Eden (sec): Thanks. Keeping thread open during rollout window for any incidents. If SOC needs anything else I'll update the annotations and retention. :white_check_mark:
